cd /opt/trading-bot/classic; python3 - <<"EOF"
import json,time
h=json.load(open("hand.json")); 
items=h if isinstance(h,list) else h.get("items",h.get("structs",h))
print(type(h).__name__, len(items))
def ts(ms): return time.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M",time.gmtime(ms/1000)) if isinstance(ms,(int,float)) and ms>1e11 else ms
n=0
for x in items:
    if isinstance(x,dict) and x.get("sym")=="CHIPUSDT":
        n+=1; print({k:(ts(v) if k in ("created","deleted","t0","t1") else v) for k,v in x.items() if k not in ("pts","points","lines")}, "keys:",list(x.keys())[:14])
print("chip structs",n)
r=json.load(open("runs.json"))
for x in r:
    if x["id"] in (51,52,53,54,55):
        t=x.get("trades") or []
        print(x["id"],x["name"],"start",ts(x["start_ms"]),"stop",x.get("stop_ms"),"ntrades",len(t),"cfg:",{k:x["cfg"].get(k) for k in ("entry_mode","entry_trigger","stages","stop_mode","tp_mode","tp_r","be_trigger") })
EOF
journalctl -u classicbot -n 15 --no-pager 2>&1 | cut -c1-220
